posts.title: Farewell, Cyberdumpster
posts.description: So, farewell then to Elon’s Cybertruck, probably the biggest automotive disaster of all time, having been handily outsold by the Ford Edsel. (Cybertruck: 63,369 sales worldwide as I write; Edsel: 116,000 sales in the US.) I’m no stranger to terrible cars. When I was growing up, my dad bought a second-hand British Leyland Maxi.
